title: Finite evaluation law for the system comparison
statement: Fix the coefficient and geometric model family of [def-sp-field-shriek-system-models] and a compactification. The finite evaluation law consists of the normalized scalar evaluation coordinates of [def-sp-field-shriek-system-evaluation], the section-identity finite support coordinates of [def-sp-field-shriek-support-evaluation], and the equation identifying every evaluation of the actual whole-system comparison with the specified finite comparison of [det-sp-reduction-direct-image] (reductionDirectImageComparison of [def-sp-reduction-direct-image-comparison]), after finite scalar extension [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor], under exactly those coordinates. This defines the law as data and a predicate, without asserting it holds.
